allOf: instructions or skills are presented as the selected integration requires
the native Legion tool surface is available
the client owns a reusable stdio MCP process and its lifecycle
release identity, version, runtime digest/provenance, catalog hash, tool-schema hash, and declarative-asset/schema hash bind before tools are exposed
each claimed host-enforcement surface is measured
a bare-command or supported exact-path proof passes in the actual launch environment
notSufficient: a test process with an inherited developer PATH

allOf: missing surfaces and their safe behavior are recorded
status and repair output identify the downgrade
only instructions and/or skills are provided
no executable workflow is registered or claimed
setup cannot safely install or operate the requested integration
the reason and remediation are reported

fullQualification.conditionalSurface: hostEnforcement is required only when an enforcement claim is made; every such claim requires measured native support.

clients.safeDowngrade: Degraded when a selected safe subset works but an executable-resolution, lifecycle, binding, or claimed enforcement proof is missing; Unavailable when setup cannot activate a safe mechanism.

fullQualification.conditionalSurface: hostEnforcement is absent unless a verified native surface is measured; it must not be claimed from instructions or MCP alone.

clients.safeDowngrade: Degraded when skills are only instruction-mediated or when any executable proof is missing; Baseline when only instructions/skills are installed; Unavailable when the requested executable route cannot be operated safely.
No executable claim is made. If even the instruction/skill projection cannot be installed without overwriting unrelated client state, Pi is Unavailable.
clients.promotionGate: A verified Pi-native mechanism and real-client qualification must be recorded before promotion to Degraded or Full.

matrixInvariants: A client receives at most one reusable Legion MCP subprocess per active client session; Legion does not self-spawn a runtime per tool call.
No client integration creates an idle Legion daemon or machine-wide socket.
A client can finish a bound process during an update, but a new incompatible mixed-version execution cannot start.
Each client status record names its selected mechanism, fidelity, missing surfaces, command proof, release binding, and remediation.
Client permission prompts remain client-owned and Legion setup consent never grants later host-governed effects.
disallowedFidelityCollapses: Do not label a skills-only integration Full or Degraded merely because a package validates.
Do not label a client Full when its executable lookup only succeeds through a developer source checkout or inherited test PATH.
Do not infer host enforcement from tool presentation, instructions, or a non-blocking event surface.
Do not retain a claimed feature after its verification or release-binding handshake fails.
